version.changelog:
onepress-deck 3.1.3

- Added PUBLISHING.md for publishing guidelines.
- Added example asset images for competitive landscape and investor update presentations.
- Updated example markdown files for investor update and market research decks.
- Improved documentation and examples in SKILL.md and CHANGELOG.md.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed deck-building helper that either writes a local HTML deck or, when configured, sends the deck task to OnePress for richer export features.

dimensions.detail: Local mode writes one self-contained HTML file in the working directory and may load ECharts/Google Fonts; connected mode uses the OnePress HTTPS API and optional uploads/downloads, which is proportionate but involves off-host data transfer.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is documented as a normal ClawHub install or copying the skill folder; no executable install scripts, package dependencies, hooks, or hidden setup behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill has broad deck/presentation triggers and explicitly excludes pure summaries, code tasks, and spreadsheets; connected mode is automatic when ONEPRESS_API_KEY is present, so users should understand that this enables remote processing.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs storing the OnePress API key in a host secret/env store after browser authorization and notes OnePress workspace memory; this is disclosed, revocable, and not implemented as a background service or system hook.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The local HTML generation, optional OnePress API submission, task polling, file upload for task-needed assets, and artifact download all fit the stated slide-deck purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install is reasonable if you want deck generation. Use local mode for confidential material, and only set or connect ONEPRESS_API_KEY when you are comfortable sending prompts and selected files to OnePress. Watch the output filename in local mode so an existing file is not overwritten unexpectedly.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: Writing a deck file to the user's working directory is the core local-mode deliverable; the artifact could better advise checking filenames before overwrite, but the behavior is disclosed and purpose-aligned.
[SQP-1] expected: The example prompts are broad natural-language deck requests, but the skill's own trigger section limits use to slide decks/presentations and excludes unrelated task types.
[SQP-2] expected: Connected mode sends task content and task-needed files to OnePress and downloads generated artifacts; this is described in the API instructions, though users should treat it as external processing for sensitive material.
[EA2] expected: The flagged 'Never ask the user' text is a secret-handling instruction telling the agent not to request API keys in chat, not an instruction to bypass confirmation for destructive actions.
